scope: List prices for video and audio generation across fal.ai, kie.ai, first-party vendor APIs and other aggregators. Derived clip costs are 5s 16:9 unless the row says 6s or 8s. Prices are before promotions unless a promo is noted. Matching model names does not establish identical output quality or an official supply channel.
method: Four parallel research passes (fal model pages, kie rate-card API POST api.kie.ai/client/v1/model-pricing/page, vendor developer pricing pages, aggregator pricing pages) plus the BytePlus ModelArk and kling.ai/dev/pricing reads made earlier the same day. WebFetch/WebSearch only; JS-rendered vendor pages read via a render proxy of the vendor URL.
